method: As plan70-FPS-after.json: requestAnimationFrame callbacks per second in the Quick Access page, 2.5 s slices back to back inside one answer, first 0.3 s of each dropped (2.2 s counted), counter started by the page reader right after A on Ask, one new chat per answer ([+] on the chat row), Strategy, thinking medium, AI characters OFF. CPU: top -b -n1 | head -15 over SSH the moment the answer passed about 400 characters. The switch (window.__bonsaiGameLoad) was set in the Quick Access page by the recorder at the start of each slice.
